def test_ready_status_keeps_optional_schema_warning_after_sync(self):
        runtime = HubRuntime()
        runtime.status = HubStatus(
            HubState.READY,
            "ready",
            datetime.now().astimezone(),
            "11.4",
            7,
            8,
        )
        runtime.last_sync_at = datetime(2026, 10, 24, 11, 22, 11)

        self.assertTrue(runtime.optional_schema_upgrade_available())
        status = runtime.status_text()
        self.assertIn("sync 2026-10-24 11:22:11", status)
        self.assertIn("optional schema upgrade available: 7 -> 8", status)

        runtime.status = HubStatus(
            HubState.READY,
            "ready",
            datetime.now().astimezone(),
            "11.4",
            8,
            8,
        )
        self.assertFalse(runtime.optional_schema_upgrade_available())
        self.assertNotIn("optional schema upgrade", runtime.status_text())

def test_manual_schema_upgrade_warns_before_breaking_legacy_clients(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        from unittest.mock import patch
        from libs.app.hub.menu import HubSettingsMenu

        # Existing schema 7 -> 8 must still require the fleet/backup warning.
        status = SimpleNamespace(schema_version=7, latest_schema_version=8)
        with patch("libs.app.hub.menu.confirm", side_effect=[True, False]) as ask, patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.refresh_status", return_value=status
        ), patch("libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.initialize_schema") as apply:
            HubSettingsMenu.initialize_schema(None, None)
            self.assertEqual(ask.call_count, 2)
            apply.assert_not_called()

        with patch("libs.app.hub.menu.confirm", side_effect=[True, True]) as ask, patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.refresh_status", return_value=status
        ), patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.initialize_schema",
            return_value=(True, "schema ready"),
        ) as apply:
            HubSettingsMenu.initialize_schema(None, None)
            self.assertEqual(ask.call_count, 2)
            self.assertIn("7 -> 8", ask.call_args_list[1].args[0])
            apply.assert_called_once_with()

        # Fresh installations have no older fleet to coordinate.
        status = SimpleNamespace(schema_version=0, latest_schema_version=8)
        with patch("libs.app.hub.menu.confirm", return_value=True) as ask, patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.refresh_status", return_value=status
        ), patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.initialize_schema",
            return_value=(True, "schema ready"),
        ):
            HubSettingsMenu.initialize_schema(None, None)
            ask.assert_called_once()

        # An already current DB also needs only the generic confirmation.
        status = SimpleNamespace(schema_version=8, latest_schema_version=8)
        with patch("libs.app.hub.menu.confirm", return_value=True) as ask, patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.refresh_status", return_value=status
        ), patch(
            "libs.app.hub.menu.hub_runtime.initialize_schema",
            return_value=(True, "schema ready"),
        ):
            HubSettingsMenu.initialize_schema(None, None)
            ask.assert_called_once()

replacements.old: - Applied migrations are recorded with version and SHA-256. A checksum mismatch is an error and must never be silently accepted.
replacements.new:
- Applied migrations are recorded with version and SHA-256. A checksum mismatch is an error and must never be silently accepted.
- Schema UI/safety logic must compare structured current/latest versions from Hub status; never hard-code a historical cutoff such as "schema < 6". Any pending migration on an existing shared DB requires the explicit fleet-updated + database-backup confirmation, while additive pending migrations may still leave Hub READY.
